verdict.rationale: Copilot's coding agent and automations let users launch and track multiple agent sessions in parallel (docs-8, docs-14, docs-15), which gives some multi-item automation capability, but there's no explicit documentation of a true bulk operation (e.g., batch-processing many files/issues/PRs in one action) as a first-class feature. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch action across many repos, files, or issues in a single invocation, and independent hands-on evidence confirming this at scale.
